Of 18 thin-wall/sliver cases the 0.9.0 contract expects refused, 9 now BUILD on 0.21.0 and match OCCT to 1e-16 (dg-wall-0.1: 10010 vs 10010, dg-wall-thru-0.1: 8020, nf-wall-0.0002: 10000.02). So truck's 'boolean drops the thin wall' bug looks fixed for those. The rebuilt row says 'wrong' only because the row builder labels expect=refuse + built as wrong; those cases are built correctly. Two new 0.21.0 refusals: sx-plain-block and sx-straight-after-slant (built on 0.9.0, now 'does not close up cleanly'). Taper fuzz identical to 0.9.0 (1000 outlines, 0 built wrong).
